decision_summary: Wichita PD operates one of the largest Flock LPR networks in Kansas (sources variously describe 191 or about 200 cameras). In October 2024 the city council approved adding 31 Flock devices: 10 under a five-year agreement and 21 under a two-year agreement including a Raven gunshot-detection component. In July 2026 resident Mason Grimmett sued the city via the Kansas Justice Institute, alleging the warrantless network violates the Kansas Constitution.

decision_summary: The Derby City Council approved Flock LPR funding in 2021; a two-month free trial was to begin in November 2021 with 7 cameras. Local reporting later described 16 cameras (9 purchased in 2021, 7 added in 2022). In 2026 two Derby Flock cameras were cut down and vandalism charges were filed.
